This indicator measures carbon dioxide emissions per person per year in tonnes of CO2 equivalent, excluding emissions from land use, land use change, and forestry. It captures fossil fuel combustion, industrial processes, and waste but not carbon sinks or deforestation.

faq.q: How often is this data updated?
faq.a: The World Bank publishes updated emissions estimates annually. This page is rebuilt from the latest release, retrieved {{retrievedAtHuman}}.

methodology: Figures are CO2 emissions per capita in tonnes of CO2 equivalent excluding LULUCF, as published in the {{sourceLink}} (indicator EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5), retrieved {{retrievedAtHuman}}. Rankings are computed among all countries with reported data for each year; countries with no reported value in a given year are excluded from that year's ranking. Trajectory sparklines index each country's series to its own {{firstYear}}–{{latestYear}} range and are not comparable in level across rows.
